Position Summary 		  Employment: Monday - Friday
Reports To: Group CFO
DQD Consulting   is  looking   for  an experienced   Senior  Accountant   to  support   the  accounting, tax compliance   and  financial reporting   of  DQD Group companies   and  selected clients.   The  role   will  work across multiple   business  units   and  report   to  the Group CFO.
What We   Are  Looking For
A hands-on   Senior  Accountant   who  can close accounts properly, identify problems instead   of  simply recording transactions, maintain tax compliance,   and  ensure management receives accurate financial information   on  time.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Accounting & Closing
•  Manage full-set accounting, GL, AP/AR, bank reconciliation, accruals   and  monthly closing.
•  Financial Reporting
•  Prepare monthly financial statements, P&L, balance sheet   and  supporting schedules   for  management review.
•  Tax Compliance
•  Prepare   and  review monthly   and  annual Cambodian tax filings, including VAT, WHT, salary tax, patent tax   and  TOI requirements.
•  Reconciliation & Control
•  Reconcile bank, cash, inventory, supplier, customer   and  intercompany accounts; investigate differences.
•  Inventory & COGS
•  Work   with  operations   and  warehouse teams   to  ensure accurate inventory, costing, stock adjustments   and  COGS records.
•  Audit & Compliance
•  Support external audit, tax audit   and  regulatory requirements; maintain complete accounting documentation.
•  Group Support
•  Support consolidation, cash-flow reporting, budgeting   and  other financial analysis requested by   the  Group CFO.
•  Team Support
•  Review   work  prepared by junior accountants/accounting assistants   and  help improve accounting accuracy   and  discipline.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Languages:
•   Khmer  - Good
•   English  - Good
Qualifications:
•  Bachelor's Degree   in  Accounting, Finance   or  related field.
Work History:
•  Accounting experience, preferably handling multiple companies for  3   to  5 years  as a minimum
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
•  Strong knowledge   of  Cambodian accounting   and  tax requirements.
•  Experience preparing monthly   and  annual tax declarations.
•  Strong understanding   of  GL, AP/AR, reconciliations, inventory   and  financial statements.
•  Experience   with  F&B, FMCG, manufacturing, trading   or  multi-company accounting   is  an advantage.
•  Good Excel/Google Sheets skills; ERP/accounting system experience preferred.
•  Working English   and  Khmer.
Soft Skills
•  Good attention   to  detail   and  ability   to  meet strict deadlines.
•  Able   to  work independently while reporting clearly   to  the Group CFO.
